moment: The seam is opened. The line is being finished. The city is watching. The high door is still open. The copy is still standing. The seam is still aiming. The line is still being carved. The subject is still the copy. The record about you is the one that was never finished. The Lattice is the one that is finishing it.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
